class.description: DOD NOTE: GameplayAudioOption manages standard and advanced audio settings across Godot's `AudioServer` buses (`Master`, `Music`, `SFX`, `Voice`, `Ambient`, `UI`, plus arbitrary custom buses), dynamic range compression, dialogue voice ducking, and spatial/cymatic acoustic propagation parameters (`CymaticMap`). It also integrates with the `GameplayStyle` cascade via `collect_rules()`, emitting `GameplayRule` modifiers that scale AI acoustic perception (`HearingRange`) on `GameAgent` entities such as the TPS Demo's Red Robots. Part of IdeamGames (game agents, players, rules, scoring, and match orchestration).
